title: The Agentic Commerce Stack — Ahnaf Prio, Best Buy
talk_summary: A Best Buy engineering manager explains the emerging agentic-commerce protocol stack (MCP, A2A, ACP/UCP, AP2) and demos a customer-agent-to-merchant-agent checkout flow with a product feed, checkout state machine, and delegated payment token. The only transferable engineering lessons are his strong emphasis on evals (behavior, protocol-compliance, latency) and using an LLM as a quality judge, plus a template-driven eval folder.

takeaways.technique: Eval suite with behavior + protocol-compliance + latency categories
takeaways.what_they_do: They maintain an evals folder with a reusable template and run scripts that check agent behavior (e.g. refusing off-topic requests, not leaking discount codes), conformance to the external protocol schema, and latency benchmarks, rather than ad-hoc testing.
takeaways.evidence_quote: working with AI and conversational experiences without evals is playing whack-a-mole

takeaways.what_they_do: They use an LLM judge for output quality, keeping it simple and grounding the rubric in product-defined best-use cases written out explicitly rather than a fancy model.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I also recommend using LLM as a quality judge... use a low like best use cases and write them out.

takeaways.technique: Protocol/schema conformance tests against external spec
takeaways.what_they_do: Because they integrate with external specs (ACP/UCP/Meta feeds), they test that their feeds and checkout calls actually conform to each schema, since non-conforming output gets silently rejected by the platform.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you want to make sure that the feeds are actually me conforming, or else they will not support it

takeaways.technique: Explicit state machine for multi-step agent transactions
takeaways.what_they_do: Checkout is modeled as an explicit three-state machine (not ready for payment / ready for payment / completed) with each transition driven by a tool call, so the agent always knows the current state and next valid action.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the checkout APIs will have state, and the three different states are not ready for payment, ready for payment, and then completed

takeaways.technique: Push structured feed instead of pull/crawl
takeaways.what_they_do: Rather than have the agent crawl each merchant's pages (M merchants x N products), merchants pre-publish a structured product feed that the platform indexes ahead of time, so lookups are cheap and current.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you send the product feed ahead of time, we can index that and be ready offload to offload when you ask for something
